slot.brief: Two blocks connected by a rope on a frictionless table (or an incline); write free-body equations and find the common acceleration and rope tension.

stem: Two blocks of masses $2\ \text{kg}$ and $4\ \text{kg}$ are connected by a light string on a smooth horizontal table. A horizontal force of $24\ \text{N}$ pulls the $4\ \text{kg}$ block. Their common acceleration is

verdicts.working: Treat both blocks as one system: a = F/(m1 + m2) = 24/(2 + 4) = 4 m s^-2.

working:
For the two-block system: $F=(m_1+m_2)a$.\n$a=\dfrac{24}{2+4}=4\ \text{m s}^{-2}$.

Independent check: Treat both blocks as one system: a = F/(m1 + m2) = 24/(2 + 4) = 4 m s^-2.
solution:
Treating both blocks as one system, the total mass is $2+4=6\ \text{kg}$.
$$a=\frac{F}{m_1+m_2}=\frac{24}{6}=4\ \text{m s}^{-2}$$
